column1: # The printed imsak (12 Nov 2026, before the Ramadan 1448 release, spec §7, O11): MUIS's Imsakiah Ramadan 1447/2026, the one table

column1: # 2027 (13 Nov 2026, ruling R185): MUIS's own Prayer Times for Singapore, Year 2027, the PDF its Islamic Calendar page links, held since
# 12 Nov 2026 and read from its text layer (archive/code/manual/sg-muis/timetable_2027.py; two independent readings equal on all 365
# days). data.gov.sg's set did not hold 2027 yet, so the monitor had nothing to prove it from: with this row Ramadan 1448's days are
# checked outright, not waited for. Held out. What that does not cover: the imsak. The Imsakiah 1448 was not on the page on
# 13 Nov 2026, so there is no imsak row for 2027: Singapore's imsak for Ramadan 1448 rests on the 30 days of the one Imsakiah
# above (1447), and no monitor source fetches an Imsakiah, so the 1448 one is a capture by hand when MUIS puts it up (sources.tsv's
# sg-muis-imsakiah, due January 2027; the step is in docs/MONITOR.md, Work by hand). On 16 Nov 2026 the monitor's capture of
# MUIS's website held 2027 too, the same as this PDF on all 365 days, and prove gated it (the last row): a second witness.
archive/tables/manual/sg-muis/2026-11-12/prayer-timetable-2027.txt
column6: F+E S D A M I
